ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a twin? (1 mark)
   A. One of two children born at the same time to the same mother
   B. A child who has no parents
   C. A person who lives next door
   D. A brother who is older

2. If the guide words are 'farm' and 'feast', which word is on that page? (1 mark)
   A. mango
   B. fashion
   C. zebra
   D. apple

3. Which word has the long vowel /ɑː/? (1 mark)
   A. market
   B. coin
   C. burn
   D. light

4. Which word rhymes with 'road'? (1 mark)
   A. load
   B. lead
   C. raid
   D. rod

5. 'As busy as a bee' means (1 mark)
   A. very busy
   B. very lazy
   C. very tall
   D. very quiet

6. Which plural is irregular? (1 mark)
   A. children
   B. boxes
   C. books
   D. dishes

7. A sentence ends with (1 mark)
   A. a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark
   B. a comma only
   C. a colon
   D. a capital letter

8. A factual question has an answer that (1 mark)
   A. is a joke
   B. is stated in the text
   C. is not in the text
   D. you invent

9. Which sentence uses 'a lot of' correctly? (1 mark)
   A. There are a lot children in the yard.
   B. There are alot of children in the yard.
   C. There are lot of children in the yard.
   D. There are a lot of children in the yard.

10. Which of these words is written with a double consonant in the middle? (1 mark)
   A. play
   B. dinner
   C. stop
   D. drink

11. Which letter is silent in 'write'? (1 mark)
   A. t
   B. r
   C. w
   D. i

12. The noun 'present' (a gift) is stressed on (1 mark)
   A. the second syllable
   B. the last letter
   C. the first syllable
   D. no syllable

13. Which visual would help you find a place you have never been to? (1 mark)
   A. A recipe
   B. A joke
   C. A map
   D. A poem

14. A caption is (1 mark)
   A. a song
   B. a kind of camera
   C. a colour
   D. words that explain a picture

15. Which word is a pronoun? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. bridge
   C. green
   D. she

16. Which date form is correct in a letter? (1 mark)
   A. May 2026 14th
   B. 14 2026 May
   C. 2026 May 14
   D. 14th May 2026

17. Which is a part of an SMS? (1 mark)
   A. The envelope
   B. The stamp
   C. The message
   D. The salutation address

18. Which word has the short sound /ʊ/? (1 mark)
   A. moon
   B. cook
   C. fruit
   D. spoon

19. You meet a new word while reading alone. What can you do? (1 mark)
   A. Use clues in the sentence and check a dictionary later
   B. Skip the whole page always
   C. Ask nobody
   D. Throw the book away

20. In the five-finger test, four or five fingers on a page mean the book is (1 mark)
   A. empty
   B. just right
   C. too easy
   D. too hard for now

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain why it is important to put the stress on the right syllable. (2 marks)

22. Write the greeting and closing for a friendly letter to your friend Wanjiku. (2 marks)

23. Correct the sentences: (a) 'Him is a driver.' (b) 'Give the pen to she.' (c) 'The bag is mine bag.' (3 marks)

24. Describe how to skim and how to scan a passage. (4 marks)

25. Arrange in alphabetical order: goat, cow, hen, dog. (2 marks)

26. Write four words with double consonants and four words with blends. (4 marks)

27. Explain how you can tell b from d when you write. (2 marks)

28. Give the meaning of clan, ancestor and adopt. (3 marks)

29. Write two sentences using a simile of your own about a celebration. (4 marks)

30. Write four sentences about your family. Use a, an and the at least once. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — One of two children born at the same time to the same mother
   Twins are two children born together to one mother.

2. B — fashion
   Fashion comes after farm and before feast in the alphabet.

3. A — market
   Market has /ɑː/ in its first syllable.

4. A — load
   Road and load both end with /əʊd/.

5. A — very busy
   Bees always seem to be working, so it means very busy.

6. A — children
   Child becomes children, not childs.

7. A — a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark
   These are the marks that end sentences.

8. B — is stated in the text
   Factual answers can be found in the words of the passage.

9. D — There are a lot of children in the yard.
   A lot of is written as three words and is followed by a noun.

10. B — dinner
   Dinner has double n.

11. C — w
   We say rite, so the w is silent.

12. C — the first syllable
   The noun is PRE-sent and the verb is pre-SENT.

13. C — A map
   A map shows where places are.

14. D — words that explain a picture
   Captions tell us what a picture shows.

15. D — she
   She takes the place of a noun.

16. D — 14th May 2026
   The usual order is day, month, year.

17. C — The message
   An SMS has a receiver, a message and a sender.

18. B — cook
   Cook has /ʊ/.

19. A — Use clues in the sentence and check a dictionary later
   Context and a dictionary help.

20. D — too hard for now
   Many unknown words show that it is too hard.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wrong stress can make a word hard to understand, and it can change the word from a noun to a verb.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Dear Wanjiku, ... Yours lovingly, (your name).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting with comma and 1 mark for the closing.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: (a) He is a driver. (b) Give the pen to her. (c) The bag is mine. / It is my bag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: To skim, look at the title, pictures and the first sentence of each paragraph to get the main idea. To scan, look quickly for key words to find a particular fact.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for skimming and 2 marks for scanning.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: cow, dog, goat, hen
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for c and d first, 1 mark for g and h last.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Double: letter, dinner, apple, bottle. Blends: train, snake, clap, flag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct group of two words, up to 4.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: b: stick first then the round part on the right. d: round part first then the stick on the right.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each letter.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: A clan is a large group of families with the same ancestor. An ancestor is a family member who lived long ago. To adopt is to take a child into your family and raise the child as your own.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: The cake was as sweet as honey. The children danced like leaves in the wind.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence with a correct simile.

30. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: I have a brother. He has an old bicycle. The bicycle is red. We ride it in the yard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence that uses the articles correctly.
